notes.title: Demo Release & Release Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

So I have a quick update on Blight Night. The release date is shifting slightly and will be launching on May 6th. I know delays can be disappointing, but I appreciate your patience. 

The reason? I’ve bunkered down completely, tightening every screw, ensuring each weapon worked flawlessly, making sure I had stuff up on my socials. Just a ton of stuff in general. This extra time has allowed me to push the game closer to the vision I had from the beginning, and I am making sure it is worth the wait.

In the meantime, the demo is officially live, so you can get a first taste of the nightmare today. Explore all you can, test your survival instincts, and get a feel of what’s to come. The demo is fully-featured, just a smaller snippet of the game. The expected playtime of the demo should be around 2 hours, and show you a lot of what’s to come in the final release. As always, feedback on your experience is hugely appreciated.

Thanks again for sticking with us. I can’t wait to share this retro-horror experience with you.

notes.title: Blight Night is Releasing April 29th
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

First off, I wanted to thank everyone who wishlisted and followed our game. It's a huge show of support for the game we're trying to make and we're incredibly thankful.

We'll be sharing additional announcements ahead of release, but this will be our first formal announcement that Blight Night is releasing on Steam on April 29th, or just three weeks away!

STEP INTO THE NIGHTMARE — IF YOU DARE

True Survival Horror Awaits: Ready to test your instincts? Explore an abandoned urban landscape, filled with danger, uncover hidden paths, and scavenge every inch for precious supplies and resources of the Old World.

Retro-Inspired, Modern-Tuned: Think classic 80s survival horror—but sharper, meaner, and reimagined for today. It feels like a forgotten relic of gaming history… only it plays like a nightmare you’ll never wake up from.

Choose Your Battles Wisely: Every enemy encounter matters. Ammo is scarce, enemies are relentless, and sometimes your smartest move is to run. With a varied arsenal at your disposal, survival is all about strategy and split-second decisions.

Light Isn’t Just Atmosphere—It’s Life: Darkness isn’t just creepy here—it’s lethal. Stay in the shadows too long, and you’re gone. Keep your light close, and your sanity closer.

Horror That Hits Deep: From glitchy VHS-style visuals to an unsettling synth soundtrack, every detail is crafted to keep you on edge and fully immersed.

-

We'll be sharing more details on release as we get closer to the date. Let us know what you're excited about and take it to the Steam Discussion forums.
